```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-deep
#| fig-cap: "Tree vs Cube matrix: CoordPath-on-tree (CoordSpaceN2) scales O(N) at 0.22 µs for 9 lookups; CoordCube-on-tree adds spatial queries at 0.28 µs for the same 9 paths — only 57 ns overhead (0.26 µs from 9 lookups, 0.02 µs path generation). The cube compensates for the tree O(N) cost by generating multiple paths at once via adjacency-driven throughput (96 Melem/s). Dense stores (CoordSpace2, CoordSpaceM3) reach 0.0185 µs for the same query."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

metrics = [
    'get 100\n(µs)',
    'missing\nkey (ns)',
    'proximity r=1\n9 paths (µs)\non CoordSpaceN',
]

# ── Store lookup cost ──
cs2_vals = [0.05, 0.39, 0.0185]    # dense: 0.39 ns * 9 ≈ 3.5 ns + 15 ns gen
csvm3_vals = [0.05, 0.39, 0.0185]  # same
csn2_vals = [0.22, 2.30, 0.285]    # tree: 9 lookups at 21.8 ns = 196 ns + 89 ns
hm_vals = [3.53, 20.1, 3.53]       # HashMap: same as get 100 (full scan)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))
x = np.arange(len(metrics))
w = 0.18

bars_dense = ax.bar(x - 1.5*w, cs2_vals, w,
                    label='Dense + CoordPath (native)', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
bars_native = ax.bar(x - 0.5*w, csvm3_vals, w,
                     label='Dense + CoordPath (mmap)', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='xxx')
bars_tree = ax.bar(x + 0.5*w, [csn2_vals[0], csn2_vals[1], csn2_vals[2]], w,
                   label='Tree + CoordPath (fallback)', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
bars_hm = ax.bar(x + 1.5*w, hm_vals, w,
                 label='HashMap', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel('Latency')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylim(0.0001, 50)
ax.legend(fontsize=6.5, loc='upper left')

# Annotate bars with values only (no arrows)
units = ['µs', 'ns', 'µs']
for bars, vals in [(bars_dense, cs2_vals), (bars_native, csvm3_vals), (bars_tree, csn2_vals), (bars_hm, hm_vals)]:
    for bar, val, unit in zip(bars, vals, units):
        if val == 0:
            continue
        fmt = f'{val:.2f} {unit}' if val >= 0.1 else f'{val:.3f} {unit}'
        off = 1.25 if val < 1 else (1.15 if val < 10 else 1.08)
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() * off,
                fmt, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=5.5, rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
